title: Unit model facing probe (test-only)
author: mewgenics-mods
description: Test-only overlay for the 3D phase M3 unit facing: the vanilla Rat gains `graphics { model { file "models/face-box.obj" yaw 0 } }`, a 0.6-tile box with a cyan front face and a yellow back face, so a turned Rat shows its model turned (the cyan face toward the camera when it faces front, the yellow one when it faces away). Load it with fw-3d (the mesh shader): `mods: _unitface, fw-3d`. Never for play.
